## The most realistic Dynamic Island on Windows

Every size, corner curve, spring and delay measured on a real iPhone 16 Pro (iOS 27) — less than 3 % difference on every animation compared.

### Download

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `Dynamic.Island_…_x64-setup.exe` | **Most people** — double-click and install |
| `Dynamic.Island_…_x64_en-US.msi` | Same app, Windows Installer package (for IT / managed PCs) |

Then launch **Dynamic Island** from the Start menu. Windows SmartScreen may warn you because the app isn't signed: click **More info → Run anyway**. Already installed? The island offers the update itself (« Installer »).

### New in this version

- 🖊️ **Whiteboard, more Wacom**: pressure curve (soft / normal / firm), stroke stabilizer, pen side button = eraser, palm ignored while the pen is near, brush preview under the pen, lower-latency ink, shortcuts (P H L A R O E, [ ], Ctrl+Z/Y/C/S); takes almost the whole screen
- Right-click menu on **3 rows** (4 per row)
- 🎨 **Whiteboard** (right-click → Dessin): almost full screen, **Wacom / pen pressure** and pen eraser, smooth strokes, pen, highlighter, line, arrow, rectangle, ellipse, eraser, any color, size, undo/redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y), plain / grid / lined background, Copy or Save as PNG
- 💧 **Color picker** (right-click → Pipette): live color under the mouse, click anywhere to copy its #hex
- 📦 **Parcel tracking**: copy or type a tracking number (Canada Post, UPS, Purolator, FedEx, DHL, Amazon) → « Suivre » opens the carrier's page
- 🔒 Unlock padlock now opens like iOS (shackle lifts and slides left)
- ✍️ « Texte copié » alert now has **Résumer · Corriger · Traduire**: Claude fixes spelling and grammar; **Google Translate** translates (French ↔ English, any language → French)
- 📅 **Exam countdowns from the right-click menu** (small calendar button): add a name and a date, see the days left
- 🌦️ **Weather**: temperature on the hover clock (your Windows location, or Boucherville), and an alert when rain or snow arrives within the hour
- 🖼️ **Copied images** in « Copiés récemment »: click one to paste it again
- ✨ **Résumer**: the « Texte copié » alert has a button to have Claude summarize it
- 📸 **Ask about a screenshot**: the capture alert has a « Demander » button — ask Claude a question about what's on the screen
- 🌀 Fans: the clicked mode turns blue, and the speed shows what the mode really applies (« Auto », « 45 % », « Arrêtés »)
- 📐 **Bigger search, same proportions as the Mac**: the measured pill, rows, icons, text and card are scaled up together to 600 pt wide; the results card shows about 5½ rows like on the Mac
- 🔍 **New search, modeled on the Mac**: the island turns into a glass **pill** (« Rechercher ou demander des infos ») with a separate **results card** underneath — apps (Start menu + Microsoft Store, with their icons), **your files** (Windows search index, never system folders), Windows Settings pages, calculator & converter, recently copied, Wikipedia / dictionary, web
- ✨ **Ask Claude**: type a question → « — Demander à Claude ». Add your Anthropic API key in Settings → Claude (stored in the Windows Credential Manager). Model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort
- ↕️ **Drag handle**: pull the bottom of any tool card (search, note, copied, timer) to make it bigger — free size, remembered per tool
- 🌀 **Asus Fan Control** in the island: live temperature & fan speeds, profiles, fixed speed, battery charge limit — small fan button in the right-click menu (needs Asus Fan Control running)
- 🔔 Alerts arriving together now **queue: 3 s each**
- ☀️ Windows' own brightness bar is hidden (the island shows it instead)
- 🔌 USB drives formatted on a Mac show their real name; **Inter** font everywhere

### What's inside

- 🎵 Music with album art, a waveform that follows the real sound, **live lyrics**, and **What's this song?** (Ctrl+Alt+S)
- ⏱️ Timers (also from the Windows Clock app), split mode with the bubble, 📞 calls with mic mute and incoming-call card, 📲 your phone through Phone Link
- ⬇️ Downloads, 🖨️ printing, 🔴 screen recording
- 🔔 40+ alerts: charger, battery saver, volume and brightness (replacing Windows' popups), clipboard, screenshot thumbnail, notifications with **Copy code**, Bluetooth, audio output, mic, USB, external screen, virtual desktop, Caps Lock, Wi-Fi, unlock padlock…
- 🧰 Right-click the island: shelf, recently copied, quick search & calculator, capture, settings
- Updates itself, starts with Windows, every display scale

---

🇫🇷 **En français :** installe le fichier `…-setup.exe`, puis lance **Dynamic Island** depuis le menu Démarrer. Si Windows SmartScreen affiche un avertissement : **Informations complémentaires → Exécuter quand même**. Déjà installée ? L'île propose elle-même la mise à jour (« Installer »).

**Nouveau :** tableau blanc encore plus grand et **mieux adapté à la Wacom** (courbe de pression, lissage, bouton du stylet = gomme, paume ignorée), menu du clic droit sur **3 lignes** ; **tableau blanc** presque plein écran (Wacom, formes, couleurs), **pipette**, **suivi de colis**, cadenas corrigé ; alerte « Texte copié » avec **Résumer · Corriger · Traduire** (Google Traduction) ; comptes à rebours d'examens dans le **clic droit**, **météo** (survol + alerte pluie/neige), **images** dans « Copiés », **Résumer** un texte copié et **poser une question sur une capture** à Claude ; recherche **plus grande** (600 pt de large), recherche **comme sur Mac** (pilule + carte de résultats : apps, fichiers, réglages, calcul, web), **Demander à Claude** (clé API dans Réglages → Claude), **poignée** pour agrandir les cartes, **Asus Fan Control** dans l'île (petit bouton dans le clic droit), alertes en file de **3 s chacune**, barre de luminosité de Windows cachée, nom des clés USB corrigé, police **Inter** partout.
